title: Nonzero-Sum Stochastic Exit Games with Singular Belief Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a two-player nonzero-sum stochastic exit game with asymmetric information. Each firm chooses the time to exit a duopoly and, conditional on remaining active, when to exit a monopoly. The asymmetry stems from privately observed exit values, while profit flows are driven by a general one-dimensional diffusion. Allowing for exit from monopoly induces singular dynamics of the associated belief process, so we construct it as a limit of regular approximations. The underlying dynamics are not described by a system of SDEs, which requires a new mathematical approach. We construct a symmetric Nash equilibrium in which the duopoly exit is a hitting time of the belief process while the monopoly exit is described through the underlying diffusion. translated_title: 具有奇异信念动力学的非零和随机退出博弈
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个具有非对称信息的双人非零和随机退出博弈。每家企业选择退出双寡头市场的时间，并且在仍保持经营的条件下，选择退出垄断市场的时间。这种非对称性源于退出价值是私下观测的，而利润流则由一般的一维扩散过程驱动。允许从垄断市场退出会导致相关信念过程呈现奇异动力学，因此我们将其构造为正则逼近的极限。由于底层动力学无法用随机微分方程组来描述，这需要一种新的数学方法。我们构造了一个对称纳什均衡，其中双寡头市场的退出是信念过程的首达时间，而垄断市场的退出则通过底层扩散过程来刻画。我们的均衡展现出一些新现象：市场可能在有限时间内被两家企业同时放弃（市场崩溃），并且具有异质退出价值的企业可能会最优地选择同时退出。
tldr: 本文针对由私下观测退出值导致信念过程呈奇异动力学、无法用随机微分方程组描述的非对称信息非零和随机退出博弈，提出新的数学方法并构造了对称纳什均衡，揭示了市场崩溃与异质企业同时最优退出等新现象。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a new mathematical approach to construct a symmetric Nash equilibrium for a two-player nonzero-sum stochastic exit game with singular belief dynamics, revealing novel phenomena such as market collapse and simultaneous optimal exit by heterogeneous firms.
